title: Document
description: A document of a released collection for one caller: a linesheet (every visible style and colour with its sizes, and prices when stated) or a lookbook (editorial pages). Its content is limited to what the caller may see (proposal 0009).

kind.description: Consumers MUST ignore documents of an unknown kind.

prices.description: none: no prices. retail: recommended retail prices. wholesale: the caller's own purchase prices; only for a logged-in retailer (a person of a retailer the brand allows, signed in to the portal), never for an API client, never in a document another caller can reach.

url.description: Signed short-lived URL or one that needs the Bearer token, as for renditions (protocol.md §5.5; proposal 0007). Wholesale documents: at most 5 minutes.

bytes.description: null when the node renders the document on request.

updated_at.description: Last change of the document's layout or of what it shows to this caller.
